kind: bounded adversarial failure-ownership source review; root acceptance and runtime verification separate
author: Codex Sol/ultra

initial_must_fix.counterexample: First checked preparation flush returns EIO (for example changed CQ error generation); unsafe remains false; quiet cleanup copies pools and invokes checked release, revoking PTEs and trying another checked flush. If the second flush succeeds after the error was handled, all resources are freed despite the accepted no-retry/no-revoke retention contract.
initial_must_fix.acceptance_reason: Current source sets unsafe on every nonzero checked preparation barrier return; the payload-copy guard and finite release guard both reject unsafe. Root made the correction; this reviewer did not edit the driver.

withdrawn_diagnostic_receipt.status: withdrawn; not a successful drain or hardware verification claim
withdrawn_diagnostic_receipt.original_agent_receipt: STOP drain:381调用quiet，但quiet:70把BATCH_CONTROL bit1当busy，而STOP设置该bit；冻结frontend在STOP完成后batch_stopped_q仍置1直到disable/重configure，故即便真实DONE+backend/composition quiet已成立也永远不能完成drain。这主要是假quarantine/永远超时，不是提前free；需分开‘issued work quiet’与sticky STOP标志。
withdrawn_diagnostic_receipt.why_wrong: Writing command value2 sets batch_stop_q. Reading control is a different layout: enable bit0, active bit1, stopped bit2, completed bit3. The quiet &2 predicate checks active and does not reject sticky stopped=4.

bounded_source_dispositions.conclusion: Only successful allocations enter nr. A failed checked cleanup marks unsafe before returning; later pool copy/release rejects unsafe. Successful cleanup zeros the full record array and nr before fallback reuse.
triggered is set before the side-effecting NEXT read; zero sets unsafe and does not match prior DONE. No safe flag is cleared by the skipped invalid-ID drain.
One bounded STOP drain clears triggered only for the owned batch ID and all-platform quiet. Otherwise unsafe remains and cleanup cannot read pools or revoke/free. STOP is not AXI cancellation.
Checked release nonzero does not zero allocation records or nr; cleanup marks unsafe and preserves the owner, run, all backing and device reference. No subsequent ioctl retries the retained owner.

Payload copy requires nr, !unsafe, !triggered, experiment mutex ownership and quiet. Metadata copy may occur after technical failure without reading DMA backing. A final delivery fault after safe release does not repeat DMA or free resources again.

On quarantine, device reference and complete owner remain; only the HPM session is released. Its release restores HPM registers and frees the session, not mappings/backing/domain. The experiment mutex remains held until quarantine is published.

evidence_boundaries: source/linux/include/linux/iommu-finite.h:24-43: exact ordinary GFP_KERNEL provenance, stable binding and no foreign map/unmap are caller preconditions.

source/linux/drivers/misc/idma.c:3019 and source/linux/drivers/iommu/riscv/iommu-platform.c:166: suppress_bind_attrs=true in current isolated source. This review accepts root current built-in/no user unbind/no other map scope; it is not a general hot-unplug or foreign kernel-user proof.
source/linux/drivers/misc/idma.c:2393 and :2127: old experiment/controlled session entry gates globally refuse a quarantined requester under the experiment mutex.
source/linux/drivers/iommu/riscv/iommu-hpm.c:55-67 and :220-227: HPM release affects HPM saved state/session only.
